persos.pose: sitting on the bench on the left, pointing at his grandmother's plate

persos.desc: grandmother in her 80s, rose-and-silver boubou, wrinkled face and a head wrap, holding one single paper plate of alloco
persos.pose: sitting on the bench in the middle, holding her plate proudly

persos.desc: father in his 40s, ochre-and-violet tracksuit, tired face, holding one single bowl of salad
persos.pose: sitting on a low stool in the foreground on the right, holding the salad bowl, gloomy

dialogue: Mamie, à ton âge, tu manges encore alloco dêh ?!
Mon petit, ton papa-là mange salade depuis dix ans. Regarde lequel paraît plus vieux.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The father stays silent the whole time. The grandson teases her, pointing at her plate, his face three-quarters to the camera. The grandmother answers proudly, tilting her chin toward the father, her face clearly visible.
chute: The grandson turns his head toward his father and bursts out laughing while the father freezes, holding his salad bowl. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the dieting father's gloomy face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: PAPA DEVANT SA SALADE DEMAIN MATIN :
mecanisme: retournement logique à double cible : la moquerie du petit sur l'âge se retourne contre son père au régime
